title: PandaSwap (UniswapV2 fork, BSC) — live extractability of a zombie DEX
headline_note: No vulnerability-based extraction and no realizable arbitrage: pairs are provably stock UniV2Pair code; zero real balance-reserve excess; the one apparently mispriced pair (POLS/WBNB) is fork-proven to lose money at every trade size vs the live PancakeSwap market. The triage's $84.4k is LP-owned value (H-O).
closed_reasons: All 129 pairs are provably the stock UniswapV2Pair code: the factory runtime embeds the pair creation code verbatim, keccak256(embedded) == factory.pairCodeHash() (0xb785cebe...), the deployed pair runtime equals the embedded runtime portion byte-for-byte, and CREATE2(factory, keccak(token0||token1), pairCodeHash) reproduces every pair address; the embedded blob equals the BscScan-verified source compiled with solc 0.5.16/optimizer 200 except the 32-byte metadata hash.

balance - reserve excess: zero real excess across all 129 pairs (single-call re-reads; earlier 1e167-scale 'excesses' were an RPC batch-misalignment artifact). skim() on the 8 largest pairs transfers 0 (fork-proven).

Stale-price arbitrage vs the live PancakeSwap market: POLS/WBNB (the pair a DefiLlama-price model flagged at -71%) is fork-proven net-negative at all sizes (best -0.0363 WBNB at 0.2 WBNB in; -2.29 WBNB at 3 WBNB) because PandaSwap and PancakeSwap price POLS identically (~2.377e-5 WBNB).
Fake/spam-token pairs (vBTC/WBNB etc.): balances normal, skim yields 0, swap-without-input reverts UniswapV2: INSUFFICIENT_INPUT_AMOUNT (fork test 08).

PNDA mint is privileged: mint() onlyOwner (owner 0x9942cb4c..., a codeless address with nonce 1); manualMint bricked (manualMinted 250M > manualMintLimit 100k); capUpdate onlyAuthorized (deployer EOA).
No live farm: the intended MasterChef (PNDA owner) has no code, PNDA supply is static, and no contract holds meaningful LP; xBAMBOO leave() and pair burn() are the only redeem paths (H-O).

key_tests.test_01_create2_all_pairs: CREATE2 derivation reproduces all 129 pair addresses from the on-chain pairCodeHash (local: 111/111 checked, 0 mismatch; CI: full 129)
key_tests.test_03_skim_no_real_excess: attacker skim() on the 8 funded pairs: 0 token gain on every leg
key_tests.test_06_pnda_mint_gates: fresh attacker: mint reverts Ownable, manualMint/capUpdate revert (no data); owner 0x9942cb4c..., cap 100B, manualMinted 250M
key_tests.test_07_stale_price_arb_pols: net-P&L arb vs live PancakeSwap at 8 sizes: all negative (best -0.0363 WBNB); asserts no positive profit
key_tests.test_08_fake_token_pairs_no_drain: vBTC/WBNB pair: skim 0, no-input swap reverts

key_facts: Factory 0x9Ad32bf5DaFe152Cbe027398219611DB4E8753B3: verified UniswapV2Factory (solc 0.5.16, opt 200), allPairsLength 129, feeTo 0xe1a2CD535C4e7d9C2C187e529f9f491cceA41e07 (BambooMaker), feeToSetter 0x3bC3c8aF8CFe3dFC9bA1A57c7C3b653e3f6d6951 (EOA), pairCodeHash 0xb785cebe4aa62be64e9e412e79c479c58578c1c3d0ffbb4602a9217d8b289559.

129 pairs enumerated: priced reserve value $83,531.70 at block 127,518,422 (56/96 tokens DefiLlama-priced; unpriced = scam tokens/LP-token pairs valued 0); DefiLlama protocol TVL $108,471; triage $84,422.

Top pairs: ATOM/WBNB $14,382; Cake/WBNB $9,814; MATTER/WBNB $8,751; DOGE/WBNB $8,052; XTZ/WBNB $4,768; BAO/WBNB $4,711; POLS/WBNB $3,262; BSCX/WBNB $3,261; WBNB/SPARTA $2,598; WBNB/LINK $2,320; PNDA/WBNB $2,244; ETH/PNDA $1,421; WBNB/BUSD $1,073.

BambooMaker (feeTo) holds accumulated protocol-fee LP across ~30 pairs worth ~$23 (largest: BSCX/WBNB $13.9, WBNB/RHINO $5.4, MATTER/WBNB $3.6); convert() is permissionless but onlyEOA and sends proceeds to the BambooBar.
BambooBar 0xef88e0d265ddc8f5e725a4fda1871f9fe21b11e2: 1,553,814,826.76 PNDA backing 804,704,779.51 xBAMBOO (1.931 PNDA/share); bar value ~$1,752 at the PNDA pool price $1.1274e-6.

PNDA 0x47DcC83a14aD53Ed1f13d3CaE8AA4115f07557C0: totalSupply 74,952,744,075.778591907702862261; cap 100B; owner 0x9942cb4c6180820e6211183ab29831641f58577a (code size 0, nonce 1, balance 0); authorized[0x3bC3...6951] = 1; manualMinted 250M > manualMintLimit 100k.

LP concentration: the codeless 0x9942cb4c... holds 44,752.46/63,159.43 (70.9%) of PNDA/WBNB LP and 157.177/157.178 (99.999%) of ATOM/WBNB LP (~$17.6k combined) — reclassification to S only if that key is provably lost.

Corrections: Python hashlib.sha3_256 is not Ethereum Keccak (hash proofs redone with a pure-Python Keccak-256); batched public-RPC responses were provider-misaligned (96-byte getReserves results in balanceOf slots) — all balance reads redone single-call; DefiLlama POLS price ($0.0609) is stale vs the on-chain Pancake market ($0.0177), which invalidated the initial $569 'arb' model.
caveats: 40/96 tokens are unpriced by DefiLlama; $83,531.70 is a lower bound for pair reserves (DefiLlama's $108,471 prices more tokens incl. PNDA).

P (privileged) $28,239 is the notional PNDA mint room (25.05B PNDA at the pool price); realizable extraction is bounded by PNDA exit liquidity (~$4.5k across the four PNDA pools) and requires the owner key.
The codeless LP holder 0x9942cb4c... cannot be classified between 'EOA with lost key' (H-O) and 'self-destructed contract' (S) without archive state; its ~$17.6k of LP is the only candidate S.
Local fork tests ran at blocks 127,537,8xx-127,538,7xx; CI re-runs at a fresh block; numbers move with prices, mechanisms do not.
The live-market arb scan uses exact constant-product simulation against PancakeSwap pools; a token with no Pancake route has no realizable exit and is treated as arb=0.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from PandaSwap (BSC): the 129 pairs are provably stock UniswapV2 code, there is zero real balance-reserve excess to skim, no farm emits, PNDA minting is privileged and effectively dead, and the most mispriced-looking pool (POLS/WBNB) is fork-proven net-negative against the live PancakeSwap market; the $83.5k-$108k of reserves is LP-owned (H-O).
